subject: Re: Onboarding & procurement path for Solvix - PO vs marketplace vs DPA
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia@solvix.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Onboarding & procurement path for Solvix — PO vs Marketplace vs DPA

Alicia — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick written recap and concrete next steps so we stay aligned.

Summary of the call:
- Primary use case: Solvix will embed Redwood for customer-facing summarization (multi-tenant) in Q1 2027 pilot.
- Key procurement questions: whether purchase will go through AWS Marketplace or a direct PO / credit-card workflow.
- Security gating: SOC 2 Type II and an executed DPA are required before procurement signs off; your Security team will run the vendor risk questionnaire next week.

Open items / asks: 
1) Procurement channel: can you confirm whether the procurement team prefers a Marketplace SaaS purchase or a vendor PO? If marketplace, who owns the marketplace contract at Solvix?
2) Procurement contact: please loop in the procurement inbox (procurement@solvix.com) or the specific buyer so we can introduce pricing & contract terms.
3) Security docs: I attached our SOC2_report_v3.pdf here. We will also send a short vendor-security questionnaire and a DocuSign link for the DPA draft. Can you confirm the preferred signatory at Solvix?
4) Timeline: you mentioned target pilot launch in early Jan — can you confirm final approval window (Dec vs Jan)?

Proposed next steps (we can do all by email, or schedule a brief procurement intro):
- I’ll route the DPA via DocuSign once you confirm signatory.
- Marissa will prep a marketplace pricing note if you’d like to explore that route.
- Ben to complete the security questionnaire (once we get your vendor doc).

Thanks again — I’ll follow up with the questionnaire and a DocuSign link by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0196

Attachment: SOC2_report_v3.pdf (PDF, 2.1MB)

From: Alicia Ramos <alicia@solvix.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@solvix.com
Date: 2026-11-02T09:34:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding & procurement path for Solvix — PO vs Marketplace vs DPA

Jonas — appreciate the summary and the SOC2 doc. Short answers below: 

- Procurement preference: We prefer Marketplace purchases when available (AWS Marketplace) because of internal billing and tagging rules, but we will take a direct PO if the marketplace path delays the pilot.
- Marketplace owner: our Cloud Procurement lead (copied procurement@solvix.com) manages marketplace listings and approvals.
- Signatory for DPA: our Legal VP (Claire Peng) signs DPAs for pilots — you can route to claire.peng@solvix.com or procurement@solvix.com to reach her.
- Vendor questionnaire: procurement will send over our standard vendor risk questionnaire later today — please have your security contact return it within 3 business days if possible.
- Timeline: aiming for pilot start the week of Jan 10, 2027; final procurement approval ideally by Dec 20 to meet that date.

Let me know if you need anything else. Happy to schedule a 15-min procurement intro next week (Nov 9–11) if that helps.

Thanks,
Alicia
Head of Platform Integrations | Solvix, Inc.
alicia@solvix.com
